summary: Iteration 31 validation of new per-job checklist CRUD + analytics PDF export. Backend pytest 14/14 PASS (1 new file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_31_checklists_pdf.py, junit: /app/test_reports/pytest/iteration_31_results.xml) covering: template create/list/update/delete regression; POST /jobs/{id}/checklist/apply + toggle; GET /jobs/{id}/checklist returns items; POST items with empty/whitespace title returns 400; PUT items updates title/required and returns 404 for missing id; DELETE items removes a single item and returns 404 for missing id; DELETE /jobs/{id}/checklist clears all; CRITICAL — after per-job add+delete+clear, the master checklist_template document items array is byte-identical to its pre-apply snapshot (no mutation); tenant isolation — a freshly registered foreign-company owner gets 404 on GET, POST items, and DELETE checklist of the demo job; analytics PDF export returns application/pdf with %PDF magic bytes and >800 byte payload for all 6 report types (overview/revenue/technicians/marketing/financing/leaderboard). Frontend playwright: logged in as demo owner, /app/checklists renders 'Checklist templates' page, new-checklist-button opens checklist-editor-modal, filled name+jobtype+2 items, save persisted as visible card with 'Template created' toast. JobDetail at /app/jobs/{seed_job_id} renders job-checklist-panel section; when empty shows '— Pick a template —' select (checklist-template-select) + Apply (checklist-apply-button). Analytics page on Overview tab shows the PDF button (data-testid=analytics-export-pdf) and NO CSV button (correct — CSV only on revenue/techs/marketing/financing/leaderboard tabs); clicking PDF triggered a real download of a 2652-byte file whose head bytes are %PDF. All P0/P1/P2 new functionality verified end-to-end. ZERO blocking bugs. One PREVIEW-ONLY console warning logged (see frontend_issues).

issues: React hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Root cause: the preview environment's Visual Editor instrumentation injects an <span data-ve-dynamic='true' x-excluded='true' style='display:contents'> wrapper inside the rendered <option>{t.name}</option> at /app/frontend/src/components/JobChecklistPanel.jsx:136. The source JSX is correct (plain text child); the span is injected by the preview build's static-imported instrumentation and will NOT appear in production builds. No functional impact — the select still works, Apply still posts the chosen template_id. Cosmetic warning only.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/checklists.py add_job_checklist_item: title.strip() is performed before the empty-title 400 guard, which is correct, but the guard appends new_item to items BEFORE raising — line 169 appends then line 168 raises 400 only if title is empty. Currently order is: build new_item (with stripped title) → if empty raise → append. Order is fine, BUT consider rejecting whitespace-only payloads at Pydantic layer (Field(min_length=1) + validator) so the 400 is centralized and item is never partially built. Defensive only — current test confirms the 400 is returned correctly.

/app/backend/routers/checklists.py update_job_checklist_item: the for/else pattern is correct but subtle — future maintainers may break it by adding an early return inside the loop. Consider explicit found=False flag.

/app/backend/routers/analytics.py _make_pdf: the KPI strip builds Paragraphs by concatenating .text attributes via string interpolation with
. Works but is fragile if a future KPI value contains '<' or '&'. Recommend html.escape on KPI keys/values before composing the Paragraph.

JobChecklistPanel.jsx renders {t.name} inside <option>. Code is correct; the preview Visual Editor mutates this. Not a code defect, but if the visual editor's tagging matters, consider using a custom shadcn Select component (which renders <div role=option>) to avoid the <option> wrapping limitation in the preview environment.

Analytics PDF endpoint has no rate limiting or size cap — large date ranges with many techs/leaderboard rows could produce very large PDFs. Consider an upper bound on rows (e.g., truncate at 500 with a 'truncated' footer) and a max-window guard (e.g., 365 days).

Per-job checklist endpoints do not call log_activity for add/edit/delete (only template-level operations do). Owners auditing 'who deleted/added a checklist item on job X' would have no trail. Recommend a log_activity('job.checklist.item.added/updated/removed', 'job', job_id, {...}) on the three mutating per-job endpoints.

rca of the issue: No bugs found this iteration. The only logged concern — React hydration warning about <span> in <option> — has been root-caused: the preview environment's Visual Editor instrumentation (the x-ve-dynamic and x-source-* attribute machinery shown in the console log) wraps dynamic JSX children with a hidden <span style='display:contents'> for click-to-edit targeting. <option> elements are W3C-restricted to text-only content, so React/HTML logs a hydration warning. The source JSX at JobChecklistPanel.jsx:136 is correct (it emits {t.name} directly). The warning will not appear in the production (non-instrumented) build. Mitigation if desired: replace the native <select> with a shadcn/ui Select component (renders div role=option), which the visual editor can decorate without violating HTML rules.
